name: @penguinharness/trace-rsi-toolkit
description: The TRACE RSI Toolkit: organize container training and evaluation, refine a modular skill bank from contrasting trajectories, and test the checkpoint selected by training scores.

penguin.description_zh: TRACE RSI 工具包：组织容器内训练与独立评测，对比轨迹修订技能库，按训练分数选择版本后测试。
penguin.short_description: TRACE RSI Toolkit: evolve skills from contrasting trajectories.
penguin.short_description_zh: TRACE RSI 工具包：对比轨迹，进化技能库。

quick_start.prompt: Use trace-rsi-toolkit to train on the selected Benchmarks, choose each training-selected skill bank, and compare it with a no-Skill baseline on three complete test repetitions.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 使用 trace-rsi-toolkit 在选定的 Benchmark 上训练，按训练分数选择技能库，与无 Skill 基线各进行三次完整测试并汇报对比结果。
